text: Nothing is added. The khoitpak heats at the bottom of the pot; steam condenses on the cold-water container and trickles out of the long spout of the shuuruun. No temperatures or times are given.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.name: distil again
steps.note: The spirit is run through the still a second time, which makes it stronger.
